Question: I Am Your Gummy Bear is the debut album by what German multilingual character?

question: I Am Your Gummy Bear is the debut album by what German multilingual character?

action.query: I Am Your Gummy Bear album

results.title: I Am Your Gummy Bear
results.text: I Am Your Gummy Bear is the debut album by Gummibär released on the Gummybear International label. It contains 20 songs interpreted by Gummibär including the big hit "I'm a Gummy Bear (The Gummy Bear Song)".

results.title: Gummibär
results.text: Gummibär is a German international multi-lingual character and virtual band based in Berlin who is known for performing the Gummy bear-related series of songs on various albums, including "I Am Your Gummy Bear" and "La La Love to Dance". It is most notable for the song and video "I'm a Gummy Bear (The Gummy Bear Song)".

results.title: La La Love to Dance
results.text: La La Love to Dance is the second studio album by Gummibär released on the Gummybear International label as a follow-up of the successful "I Am Your Gummy Bear". It contains 19 songs interpreted by Gummibär.
